verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Every knee will bow, every tongue confess
Every heart will cry out Your name
You are welcome here, welcome

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Every life will see the glory of our King
Jesus come and reign in our hearts
You are welcome here, welcome

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Holy Spirit come, come in power
My life is Your, my life is Yours
Holy Spirit come, start a fire
My life is Your, my life is Yours

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
God of heaven and earth, we long for more of You
Come and meet with us as we pray
You are welcome here, welcome

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Here I am, send me
Here I am, send me
Here I am, send me, God
Woah

verse.name: b2
verse.lines:
You send me to the nations
You send me to my neighbours
Send me with Your love, woah
